fusions.name: Scruff Hold
fusions.desc: Consumes every affliction on the target, adding 1.5 times their remaining damage to this blow, and deals 20 damage to an enemy at or below 25% health. The target is [Pinned] for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Patting Flurry
fusions.desc: A flurry of quick pats deals 4 damage to every enemy within 2 tiles. You move 15% faster for 3 seconds after using it.

fusions.name: Outstretched Paw
fusions.desc: For 20 seconds, your attacks and spells reach 40% further.

fusions.name: Sure Grip
fusions.desc: When you land a critical hit, you regain 4 stamina. Once every 6 seconds.
